annotations.text:
Dense Tamil-cinema portal, in the genre of the reference — packed category blocks, thumbnail-left rows, wide red category bar, heavy footer.

Not copied: Behindwoods' own wordmark, logo or branded elements.

Headlines are the real ones from the aggregator as of 7 Sep, so you can judge the density honestly.

Two levers on each artboard:

Accent — one colour drives the nav bar, section rules, category tags and trending numbers.

Density (desktop) — Packed is the reference feel. Roomy opens the section, card and row spacing if it reads too tight.
